titel: Halfway Through 2026: Points, Cards & Travel Update

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: A review of credit cards opened, points earned, and trips taken in 2026.
kurzfassung: Michelle from Fancy Travel Pointers reviews the first two-thirds of 2026, detailing the five credit cards she and her husband opened and the 760,000 points they earned. She covers trips to Bora Bora, Mexico, Asia, and Disneyland, utilizing transferable points, free night certificates, and the Southwest Companion Pass. Additionally, she shares early booking plans for 2027, including Qatar Q-suites to the Maldives.
stichpunkte: Michelle and her husband opened five credit cards in 2026, consisting of two personal hotel cards and three business cards with elevated offers.
The new credit card sign-ups generated 760,000 points and two free night certificates.
Travels in 2026 included Bora Bora on Air Tahiti Nui and Marriott points, multiple trips to Mexico, an Asia trip using over a million points, and a Disneyland getaway.
The Southwest Companion Pass remained a core travel strategy, paired with Alaska Miles and various hotel free night certificates.
Early bookings for 2027 feature Qatar Q-suites to the Maldives, secured via a 30% transfer bonus.
Credit score remains at 827 due to strategic bank rotation between spouses and paying balances in full and on time every month.

kapitel.titel: 2026 Credit Card Strategy and Points Earned

clips.hook: Four major international trips in one year is too much
clips.text: The hosts reflect on scaling back their heavy international travel schedule, which included four major overseas trips in 2025, after finding the pace exhausting.

clips.hook: Two free night certificates and 260,000 points from two card signups
clips.text: An overview of a recent credit card application strategy yielding five total accounts—two personal and three business—with large welcome bonuses and low spending requirements.

clips.hook: Airline award pricing drops significantly just for holding the card
clips.text: An observation on dynamic airline pricing out of Denver, showing business class award tickets dropping from 200,000 points down to 80,000 points simply by logging into a co-branded credit card account.

clips.hook: Staying at a two-thousand-dollar-a-night hotel using a free night certificate
clips.text: A detailed stay at the Park Hyatt Cabo del Sol using free night certificates to cover a luxury room normally priced above $2,000 per night.

clips.hook: Booking Qatar Q-suites and traveling to the Maldives next summer
clips.text: Booking Qatar Airways Qsuites to the Maldives via Doha for roughly 70,000 points and 200 dollars in taxes per passenger by combining three separate reservation methods.
